generated_rule: New-position analysis may output only a legally verified Taiwan-market executable price for the current or next legal trading session; otherwise it must say unable to determine. Existing-position management uses four user position facts: buy time, current shares, current total cost and current average cost. Missing, unverified or materially inconsistent inputs are never imputed.

entry_decision_9plus3.reason: The production entry contract requires nine verified entry factors plus verified US-market, TAIFEX TX and international-event contexts. Legal historical OHLC, all required contexts, production-equivalent OOS validation, entry-range execution/reachability validation and confidence calibration are not all complete.

entry_scanner_9plus3.reason: TOP10 must use exactly the same 9+3 contract as single-stock entry analysis. No former short/mid/long ranking or buy-price model may substitute. Ranking remains blocked until all required legal data and formal validation gates pass.
required_before_pass: all nine entry factors for every candidate

holding_rules.position_input_contract: User-supplied first buy time + current shares + current total cost + current average cost, or user-entered remaining lots from which those fields are deterministically derived. No position field may be inferred from market data or AI.
holding_rules.reason: Deterministic holding management is available from user position facts plus legally verified completed-session market facts. Missing price history, corporate-action state or active risk state stays unknown and only suppresses the affected enhancement; it does not recreate an OOS lock. No win rate, probability or calibrated confidence is claimed.
minimum_required: legally usable verified latest completed-session close
optional_enhancements: additional verified OHLC bars for support/resistance
